name: puyo-party-cell
description: Real-time competitive Puyo Puyo 1v1 cell (Canvas 2D) built on the existing realtime building blocks — lockstep deterministic engine, server-authoritative sync and voice

roomId.description: Room identifier for the game. Null = user enters a room name in the lobby.

_discovery.describe: Real-time competitive Puyo Puyo 1v1 cell (Canvas 2D) built on the existing realtime building blocks (useDistributedState + usePartyCalls + server-authoritative backend). Two players share a room, get a shared deterministic seed, simulate the same piece sequence locally (lockstep, zero latency), attack each other with garbage (submit_garbage) and end when a board tops out (game_over). No new infrastructure: a single distributed state branch (game) over Redis Pub/Sub plus Cloudflare Calls for opt-in voice.
use_cases: Play a competitive Puyo Puyo match 1v1 with a friend in the same room
Attack the opponent with garbage from chains (server-arbitrated)
Talk trash over opt-in voice while playing (Cloudflare Calls)
